description: Workflow gate for Bench P3 W1 — Markdown wiki: front matter, full-text search, tags (Arm C: Invoker DAG, mixed Codex)

config.prompt:
Read SPEC.md first; it is the source of truth. This task is one step of a larger change. Implement only this step:
Review the whole change against SPEC.md, fill any missing test coverage for front matter, index sync, search, and tags, and update README.md to document the new endpoints and configuration.
Run npm test and npm run build before committing; both must pass. Commit your changes.
Do it locally: do not use Invoker, invoker-cli, or any other delegation.

Read SPEC.md first; it is the source of truth. This task is one step of a larger change. Implement only this step:
Parse the front-matter block described in SPEC.md (title, tags in [a, b] or a, b form; tags trimmed, lowercased, de-duplicated, sorted). Title precedence: front-matter title, then first '# ' heading, then slug. Page responses include tags and body excludes the front matter; GET /pages includes tags. Update existing tests and add new ones.
Run npm test and npm run build before committing; both must pass. Commit your changes.
Do it locally: do not use Invoker, invoker-cli, or any other delegation.

Read SPEC.md first; it is the source of truth. This task is one step of a larger change. Implement only this step:
Reimplement GET /search on the FTS5 index exactly as in SPEC.md: case-insensitive, AND of all terms, at most 20 results, title matches weighted above body matches, numeric score where higher is better, snippet with matched terms wrapped in **, user punctuation and quotes treated as plain text and never causing a 500, and 400 for a missing or blank q. Add tests including ranking and punctuation.
Run npm test and npm run build before committing; both must pass. Commit your changes.
Do it locally: do not use Invoker, invoker-cli, or any other delegation.

Read SPEC.md first; it is the source of truth. This task is one step of a larger change. Implement only this step:
Add a SQLite index (node:sqlite) with a migration runner and schema version table, an FTS5 table over title and body, and tag storage. Use the createApp options indexPath (default WIKI_INDEX_PATH or wiki-index.sqlite) and app.locals.close() from SPEC.md. Files are the source of truth: synchronize the index with the pages directory on startup (added, changed, removed files) and update it in PUT and DELETE before responding. Add tests.
Run npm test and npm run build before committing; both must pass. Commit your changes.
Do it locally: do not use Invoker, invoker-cli, or any other delegation.

Read SPEC.md first; it is the source of truth. This task is one step of a larger change. Implement only this step:
Add GET /tags (tag and count, sorted by count desc then tag asc) and GET /tags/:tag (slug and title sorted by slug, case-insensitive tag, unknown tag returns []) using the index. Add tests.
Run npm test and npm run build before committing; both must pass. Commit your changes.
Do it locally: do not use Invoker, invoker-cli, or any other delegation.

description: Visible verification gate: install, unit tests, build.

config.command: npm ci --no-audit --no-fund && npm test && npm run build
